panel_fe.label: Panel / fixed effects
panel_fe.note: Follow the same households or people over time; within-unit change removes time-invariant confounders.

did_rcs.label: Difference-in-differences with repeated cross-sections
did_rcs.note: Compare changes across places exposed to a policy at different times; needs consistent geography across rounds.

its_admin.label: Interrupted time series / event study on administrative data
its_admin.note: High-frequency records around a rollout date; watch reporting changes and seasonality.

spatial.label: Spatial / geospatial linkage
spatial.note: Link outcomes to location-based exposures (distance, night lights, climate); respect coordinate displacement.

cross_country.label: Cross-country comparison
cross_country.note: Country-year panels for benchmarking; harmonised definitions but few observations per country.

descriptive.label: Descriptive monitoring
descriptive.note: Levels and trends for targeting and benchmarking; not causal on its own.

datasets.name: National Family Health Survey (NFHS)
datasets.custodian: IIPS for the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
datasets.latest: NFHS-6 (fieldwork May 2023–Dec 2024); state fact sheets released May 2026, district fact sheets August 2026
datasets.access_note: Fact sheets and reports open; unit-level data for earlier rounds through the DHS Program (registration). NFHS-6 unit-level release: to verify.
datasets.what: India's flagship demographic and health survey, representative at district level since NFHS-4.
cautions: Infant mortality from NFHS is based on 5-year birth histories and is not directly comparable with annual SRS rates.
District estimates carry wide confidence intervals; district boundaries change between rounds.
NFHS-5 fieldwork was split before and during COVID-19.

datasets.name: Sample Registration System (SRS)
datasets.custodian: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
datasets.structure: Aggregate vital rates from continuous registration in sample units
datasets.rounds: Annual statistical reports; maternal mortality special bulletins pooled over three years
datasets.latest: Special Bulletin on Maternal Mortality 2020–22 (published June 2025)
datasets.access_note: Reports and bulletins open through the Census of India data catalogue.
datasets.what: The official source for annual infant mortality and three-year maternal mortality ratios by state.
cautions: Maternal mortality is reported only for larger states and state groups.
Three-year pooling smooths short-run changes; not available by district.

datasets.name: NSS: Household Social Consumption on Health
datasets.access_note: Unit-level data through the national microdata portal (registration). 80th-round unit-level release: to verify.
datasets.what: The main source for out-of-pocket and catastrophic health spending, hospitalisation and insurance in India.
cautions: Recall periods differ (15 days for outpatient care, 365 days for hospitalisation).
Questionnaire changes between rounds affect comparability; sub-state estimates are limited to NSS regions.

datasets.name: Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES)
datasets.latest: HCES 2023–24; report and unit-level data released
datasets.access_note: Unit-level data through the national microdata portal (registration).
datasets.what: Household consumption, including medical spending, for poverty and health-spending burden measures.
cautions: The 2022–23 and 2023–24 rounds use a revised multi-visit design and are not directly comparable with 2011–12.
Medical spending here is a budget share, not an episode-level cost as in the NSS health rounds.

datasets.name: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)
datasets.structure: Repeated cross-section with an urban rotational panel
datasets.rounds: Annual from 2017–18; redesigned from January 2025 with the district as the basic stratum; migration module 2020–21
datasets.latest: District-level estimates first released September 2026 (PLFS January–December 2025)
datasets.access_note: Unit-level data through the national microdata portal (registration).
datasets.what: India's main labour-market survey; district-representative since the 2025 redesign.
cautions: The 2025 redesign creates a break in the series.
The urban panel follows households for only four quarters.
District estimates are available only from 2025.

datasets.name: NSS 64th round: Employment, Unemployment and Migration
datasets.access_note: Unit-level data through the national microdata portal (registration).
datasets.what: The detailed pre-2020 baseline for internal migration and remittances in India.
cautions: Migration is defined by change in usual place of residence, which differs from the Census definition (place of last residence).

datasets.name: Longitudinal Ageing Study in India (LASI)
datasets.custodian: IIPS with Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health and USC
datasets.latest: Wave 1 public; wave 2 release status to verify
datasets.access_note: Through IIPS and the Gateway to Global Aging Data (registration).
datasets.what: State-representative panel of older adults, harmonised with the HRS family of ageing studies.
cautions: Panel analysis requires wave 2; check release status.
LASI-DAD (dementia sub-study) is a separate, smaller sample.

datasets.name: India Human Development Survey (IHDS)
datasets.latest: IHDS-3 fieldwork 2022–23; public release status to verify
datasets.access_note: Through ICPSR (free account).
datasets.what: India's only national household panel covering health, gender, income and migration together.
cautions: Attrition and household splits need handling.
District identifiers follow 2011 boundaries.

datasets.name: Health Management Information System (HMIS)
datasets.custodian: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
datasets.rounds: District-level reporting from October 2008; facility-level from 2010–11
datasets.access_note: Standard reports and downloads open on the HMIS portal.
datasets.what: Service-delivery records from public facilities, ideal for high-frequency analysis around programme rollouts.
cautions: Counts of services delivered, not population rates; denominators must be estimated.
Mostly public facilities; reporting completeness varies by state and year.

datasets.name: National Health Accounts Estimates (NHA)
datasets.custodian: National Health Systems Resource Centre, MoHFW
datasets.latest: NHA 2022–23: out-of-pocket spending 43.4% of total health expenditure (39.4% in 2021–22)
modules: total, government and out-of-pocket health spending
datasets.access_note: Reports open.
datasets.what: India's official health-spending accounts, following the System of Health Accounts framework.
cautions: Methods are revised between editions; use the latest edition's back-series for trends.
Out-of-pocket estimates draw partly on NSS and HCES surveys.

datasets.name: Health Dynamics of India (formerly Rural Health Statistics)
datasets.custodian: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
datasets.latest: Health Dynamics of India (Infrastructure and Human Resources) 2022–23, facilities as of 31 March 2023
modules: health workforce: sanctioned, in position, shortfall
datasets.access_note: Annual publication open.
datasets.what: Public-sector facilities and health workforce by level of care, with district-wise tables.
cautions: Public sector only.
Shortfalls are measured against population norms, which were revised over time.

datasets.name: NITI Aayog State Health Index
datasets.custodian: NITI Aayog with MoHFW and the World Bank
datasets.rounds: Rounds I–IV; Round IV covers 2019–20 (released December 2021)
datasets.latest: Round IV confirmed; later rounds to verify
datasets.access_note: Report and scores open.
datasets.what: A composite ranking of state health-system performance, reported as overall and incremental scores.
cautions: Composite of many indicators with fixed weights; changes can reflect indicator revisions.
States are ranked within categories (larger states, smaller states, UTs).

datasets.name: Census of India 2011 (incl. D-series migration tables)
datasets.custodian: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
datasets.access_note: Tables open on the Census of India website.
datasets.what: Village and town-level population and migration tables; the standard source of denominators.
cautions: Now dated; district boundaries have changed since 2011.
Migration is by place of last residence, unlike NSS/PLFS.

datasets.name: SHRUG: Socioeconomic High-resolution Rural-Urban Geographic Platform
datasets.rounds: Dozens of datasets for 500,000+ villages and 8,000 towns over about 25 years (v2.x)
datasets.access_note: Module downloads open.
datasets.what: Links Indian villages and towns across censuses and satellite data with common identifiers.
cautions: Uses its own 'shrid' identifiers rather than official codes.
Few direct health outcomes; mainly exposures and controls to link with health data.

datasets.name: Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS)
datasets.latest: Programme status after 2025 changes in US funding: to verify
datasets.access_note: Unit-level data and displaced GPS coordinates on request (registration).
datasets.what: Comparable household surveys across 90+ countries, with geocoded survey clusters.
cautions: Cluster coordinates are displaced for privacy: up to 2 km (urban), 5 km (rural) and 10 km for 1% of rural clusters.

datasets.name: Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS)
datasets.rounds: MICS1–MICS7; MICS7 runs to the end of 2026
datasets.access_note: Datasets downloadable after registration.
datasets.what: Household surveys on children and women, covering many SDG indicators.
cautions: Module content varies by country and round.

datasets.name: Living Standards Measurement Study (LSMS)
datasets.rounds: Country surveys since the 1980s; LSMS-ISA panels in Sub-Saharan Africa
datasets.access_note: Through the World Bank Microdata Library.
datasets.what: Multi-topic household surveys, several with panels and georeferenced households.
cautions: Questionnaires differ by country; check comparability before pooling.

datasets.name: World Development Indicators / Health, Nutrition & Population Statistics
datasets.access_note: Open (CC BY 4.0).
datasets.what: Harmonised country-year indicators compiled from international agencies.
cautions: Many series are modelled or compiled from other agencies; check the original source.

datasets.name: Global Health Expenditure Database (GHED)
datasets.access_note: Open.
datasets.what: Comparable national health accounts across countries.
cautions: National figures (for example India's) may differ from the country's own latest NHA edition.

datasets.name: Global Health Observatory (GHO)
datasets.access_note: Open, with an API.
datasets.what: WHO's portal for health statistics across its member states.
cautions: Many values are WHO estimates, not direct country reports.

datasets.name: Global Burden of Disease (GBD 2023)
datasets.custodian: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME)
datasets.rounds: 1990–2023 for 204 countries and 660 subnational locations, including Indian states
datasets.access_note: Open for non-commercial use through GBD Results.
datasets.what: Comprehensive, comparable estimates of disease burden and risk factors.
cautions: Modelled, not observed: estimates depend on model assumptions and are revised between rounds.
Do not treat as independent data points in regressions without care.

datasets.name: National Health Workforce Accounts (NHWA)
datasets.access_note: Open through the NHWA data portal and GHO.
datasets.what: Standardised health-workforce indicators, including density of doctors, nurses and midwives.
cautions: Coverage and definitions vary with country reporting.

datasets.name: OECD Health Workforce Migration indicators
datasets.rounds: Annual, from the OECD/Eurostat/WHO-Europe Joint Questionnaire
datasets.access_note: Open through OECD data.
datasets.what: Where foreign-trained doctors and nurses work in OECD countries, and where they trained.
cautions: Destination-country data: covers OECD and partner countries only.

datasets.name: Migration & Remittances Data (KNOMAD / World Bank)
datasets.rounds: Bilateral migration matrices for 2010, 2013 and 2017; annual bilateral remittance estimates
datasets.latest: KNOMAD discontinued; last dataset released for 2023
datasets.access_note: Open downloads.
datasets.what: Corridor-level migrant stocks and remittance flows.
cautions: Bilateral remittances are modelled from migrant stocks and incomes, not observed flows.
